Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A Cataclysm Engineered Through the Grid", "body": "Michelle stakes out her strongest claim of the exclusive hour, that the mud flood reset was not an accident but a deliberate surge of energy sent through the Earth's grid, one she ties to the Philadelphia Experiment and to Aleister Crowley as an act of ceremonial magic. She points to locomotives left sitting in the New Jersey Pine Barrens as evidence that everything simply stopped, and argues the polarity of the Earth's magnetic field was flipped. Chance offers a gentler alternative, that the controllers knew a cyclical event was coming and merely made it worse while capitalizing on the outcome."}, {"title": "A Growing Earth and Electrolysis Mud", "body": "Chance opens the members-only hour with his own speculative cosmology, that the realm may be a closed alchemical battery with the sun as cathode and the moon as anode, cyclically running low on charge until an electrolysis event recharges it. His evidence is a hydrogen device called the Aquacure, which generates a sludge chemically identical to its stainless steel plates even though those plates never lose any mass, and which also makes a little new water. If a machine can conjure new earth and new water from nowhere, he asks, why not a world that grows and floods on a cycle?"}, {"title": "The Pine Barrens Line and Its Installations", "body": "Following a single alignment through the New Jersey Pine Barrens, Michelle lands on a corridor holding Montauk Point, the privately owned Gardner's Island, and Plum Island with its government laboratory rated for microbes that can kill by inhalation. A few miles on sits Brookhaven National Laboratory and its Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider, which she calls a reverse of CERN. Ringing all of it is some of the most expensive real estate in the country. Chance suggests the proximity is no accident, that membership in those circles may come with obligations nobody advertises."}, {"title": "An Earth Expressing Sickness in Its Land", "body": "The hour's central weave belongs to Chance, who works with people's energy fields and argues that disease begins as stuck energy long before it becomes physical. He extends that anatomy to the planet, so Michelle's repeated finding of swamps, bogs and deserts sitting along the ley lines reads to him as an Earth expressing illness. He pushes it further into society, where compartmentalization stops one part of a system from speaking honestly to another, and where a sufficiently fractured person, or culture, leaves an evacuated space for something else to move in. Michelle answers with MKUltra and trauma-based mind control as the documented version of the same thing."}, {"title": "Reharmonizing the Realm From Your Own Backyard", "body": "Against all the wreckage, both land on optimism with a practical edge. Chance describes planting orgonite tubes of layered crystal and metal around the towers near his house and watching chemtrails evaporate instead of spreading, and he offers metronomes left in a room drifting into unison as proof that reality has a self-ordering principle. Michelle answers that each of us can do something within our own field with conscious intention, and that we get to be here and participate in bringing things back to harmony and balance. She closes on a line from Drunvalo Melchizedek, that the ancients need us and we need them."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I see a civilization that lasted for a very long time that was brilliant, that was integrated all over the Earth, free energy, the same things on different continents.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think maybe the ancients with their usage of the Earth grid was about basically engineering the energy of the Earth to become more conscious and aware in and of itself.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When you look at biology and look at nature, nature really likes to create backup copies of something.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm seeing how that sudden cataclysmic event could wipe out this highly advanced civilization of giants erased from our collective memory, and that it was caused by these bloodline-connected families still with us today.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Something happened. I believe there was energy that went through the grid, that blew the grid out, that caused the polarity to change of the Earth's magnetic field.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When you put dissonance next to coherence, or negativity next to positivity, trauma versus harmony, the harmony always wins.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We've been barraged with all of these things. But people have never been so awake.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It's a one-way street. Once you unplug from the big lie, it's not like you're going to just go back into it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The entire Earth is a giant graveyard, though. It's eons of dirt that used to be the bodies of some other thing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Maybe something cyclical happens, but there's been one continuous beautiful civilization for a very long time.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
